name: Netherlands (Royal Standard)
description: A square orange flag divided into quarters by a nassau-blue cross bearing the crowned royal arms at its centre; each orange quarter contains a blue bugle-horn.
history: Adopted in 1908 by Queen Wilhelmina and still in use. The orange field and bugle-horns refer to the Principality of Orange; the blue cross carries the arms of the Kingdom.

features.role: crowned royal arms of the Netherlands
